title: Buttons
summary: A native button with Framework presentation: size, appearance, colour role or status, optional start and end icons, height and radius. loading sets aria-busy and disables it against repeated activation.

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

root-class.description: Extra classes applied to the inner button element.

root-style.description: Inline style declarations set on the root element the component draws, custom properties included.

height.description: The control height (owner decision C27), separate from size: size sets the text, the icons and the inner scale, height picks the control height from the size's tightness steps of the adaptive-sizing contract -- low, default, high, highest, the size's usual step and its neighbours on the UI height ladder. Desktop 1/3 24/28/32/40, 1/2 28/32/40/48, 1 32/40/48/56, 2 40/48/56/68, 3 48/56/68/80; phone 1/3 20/24/28/36, 1/2 24/28/36/44, 1 28/36/44/52, 2 36/44/52/64, 3 44/52/64/76. The side padding grows with the height by half of what the height adds, so the gap from the end to the icon stays the same. A compact region (data-sf-density) shifts the steps one down and height picks the neighbour there. A value outside the list reads as default, with one console warning.

appearance.description: How the button looks: default (filled), tonal, outline, ghost (no fill or edge until hovered; rule C15) or surface (a faint fill on the neutral alpha ramp and a border). link is ghost's former name; a link is made by href, not by the look.

scheme.description: Which colour family the control takes. on-surface-variant is the on-surface family one step quieter: the fill and the edge of on-surface, the label and the icons in --sf-on-surface-variant (a search trigger that reads like a field). With appearance surface on-surface-variant is retired (1.11.0, as on the icon buttons, C15): it draws as on-surface until 2027-01-01 and warns once. What the control is about is the status axis; a status set there wins over this.

status.description: What the control is about (rule C13): danger, a control that deletes, discards or cannot be undone. It paints with the error roles -- the red of an error -- and behaves exactly like a primary control. error is its former name on a control.

text-position.description: How the label aligns inside a button wider than its content: start, center or end (the text-align utility on the label).

text.description: Visible button text when no text slot is provided.

segment.description: The button's place in a joined group: start, middle or end squares the corners it shares with its neighbours; empty: a standalone button.

icon-position.description: Placement for the single icon shortcut.

spacing.description: Deprecated (decision C27, until 2027-01-01): the side padding only -- compact, normal, comfortable or spacious -- at the same height. It keeps working as before with a console warning and is not turned into height; write height for a lower or higher button.

full-width.description: The control fills its container, as sf-segmented's full-width does, and its content stays in the middle; without it the button is as wide as its content (owner decision C36). The height does not change.

loading.description: Loading state: the spinner at the icon's size in place of the start icon (else the end icon); without an icon it lies over the label, which keeps its place, so the width does not change. The spinner takes the page's look (data-sf-spinner) and the label's ink. The inner button is unavailable while it loads but keeps its scheme colour (owner decision C36); a button that is also disabled wears the disabled look.

form.description: The id of the form the inner button submits or resets, as a native button's form attribute: a button outside the form (a wizard's footer) submits it. Not written on a link.

name.description: The name the inner button submits its value under, as a native button's name.

value.description: The value the inner button submits under name when it is the submitter (next, skip); for a cycle, the current item's value, which a press moves to the next one.

href.description: An address: the button draws a link (an <a href>) with the button's look; role link, Enter and the browser's link keys follow it. A relative address, a fragment, http(s), mailto or tel; any other scheme draws a button. native-type, expanded and pressed do not apply; disabled or loading, the link has no href and says aria-disabled.

target.description: Where a link (href) opens, as an <a target>: _blank opens a new tab. Not written on a button.

rel.description: The link's relation, as an <a rel>. A link that opens in a new tab (target _blank) with no rel says noopener noreferrer, so the new page cannot reach this one. Not written on a button.

shortcut.description: A key combination drawn at the end of the button as the kbd component's soft caps in the label's ink: words joined by +, e.g. mod+k (⌘K on a Mac, Ctrl K elsewhere), shift+mod+p (⇧⌘P, Ctrl Shift P), shift+/, / or escape. mod is Cmd on Apple platforms and Ctrl elsewhere. The only input: a page never styles the keys. Also written as aria-keyshortcuts on the inner button. Empty: no keys

shortcut-listen.description: The button listens to its shortcut on the page and is pressed by it, as by a click. A combination without mod, ctrl, alt or meta is not heard while focus is in an editable field

expanded.description: Whether the panel this button opens is open: aria-expanded on the inner button; absent says nothing

pressed.description: Whether this toggle button is on: aria-pressed on the inner button and the pressed look -- the primary container fill, its ink, no visible edge and the icon filled (rule C12); pressed="false" says off; absent, the button is not a toggle and nothing is said

text-pressed.description: The label while the toggle is on, for a toggle whose label changes («В избранное» → «В избранном»). Set, the label says the state and aria-pressed is not written; the pressed look still follows pressed. Empty: the label stays the same and aria-pressed says the state

theme-cycle.description: A ready theme switch over SF.Loader's theme (the contract of sf-segmented's theme-switch: themePreference, setTheme, sf-theme-change). Present and empty: three values, «as the system», light and dark, in the owner's order -- first the theme opposite to the visible one, then the other, then «as the system» (rule D11d); "light dark": two values, every press flips the visible theme. The icons are contrast, light_mode and dark_mode; the words are the page language's («Тема: светлая. Нажмите — тёмная»). cycle is ignored beside it.

aria-label.description: Accessible label for icon-only or custom buttons.

type.description: Legacy name for appearance, still honoured. See contracts/public-api-axes.json.

cycle.description: One button, several values (rule D11d): the items {value, label, icon, pressed?} a press steps through, wrapping at the end. value is the current item. The name and the icon say the current value («Скорость: 1,5×»), the tooltip says the current and the next, and a polite live region says the new value after a press; change {previous, value, item} follows. Not a toggle: pressed and text-pressed are ignored beside it, with one console warning.

onClick.summary: Adds a listener for click on the host. Returns the element.

onFocus.summary: Adds a listener for focusin on the host. Returns the element.

onBlur.summary: Adds a listener for focusout on the host. Returns the element.

onMouseEnter.summary: Adds a listener for mouseenter on the host. Returns the element.

onMouseLeave.summary: Adds a listener for mouseleave on the host. Returns the element.

setDisabled.summary: Sets the disabled attribute when nextValue is truthy and removes it otherwise. Returns the element.

sf-button-press.summary: A press: a click, Enter or Space on the inner button or link, or the shortcut-listen key; the detail is an empty object. Not sent by click() on the host, nor by a disabled or loading button.

change.summary: A cycle (cycle or theme-cycle) moved to its next value after a person's press; dispatched on the host, bubbles and is composed, after press on sf-button. A theme cycle sends it after SF.Loader.setTheme has drawn the theme. Not sent by a button that is not a cycle.

item.description: The item now current: {value, label, icon, lang, pressed}.

accessibility.focus: Keep visible focus on the active control.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-button when the interface needs the buttons behavior.
do_not: Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not move host data or access decisions into the component
